mods.description:
# Faircroft Bank Bridge (testing)

This addon polls Railway for developer-only `issue_funds` commands and applies them through the existing `Bnk_BankComponent`/`Bnk_BankManagerComponent`. Railway remains the command ledger; the in-game bank manager remains authoritative.

Copy `bridge_config.example.json` to `$profile:bANK bRIDGE/bridge_config.json` on the game server and set:

- `Enabled`: `1` only during controlled testing.
- `RailwayBaseUrl`: the current Railway service URL.
- `RailwayApiKey`: the same bridge key already accepted by the existing Arma routes.
- `ServerId`: the Railway server identifier (`default` unless a second server was configured).

The bridge does not call the PWA, inspect or change the payment PIN, or mutate the Railway cash/bank ledger. The Railway Dev Tools action is disabled unless `BANK_BRIDGE_TEST_MODE=1` is set. Normal payment routes and four-digit admin 2FA remain unchanged.

The target player must be online and linked when a command is processed. Offline commands are returned to `pending` for a later poll. Amounts are integer in-game currency and are bounded by the bank component's existing limit.

mods.description:
# Cam Project — Bodycam Camera Framework

This addon is the first implementation stage of a BODYCAM-inspired realism project for Arma Reforger.

## Current scope

- Forces first-person while the player is on foot.
- Lowers and offsets the first-person viewpoint to suggest an upper-chest/shoulder-mounted camera.
- Blends the viewpoint back toward the eye while aiming down sights so weapon alignment remains usable.
- Adds restrained breathing motion and acceleration inertia.
- Keeps the extra periodic gait disabled by default so it does not stack with Reforger's existing first-person weapon/character animation.
- Runs as client-side camera presentation and does not change damage, ballistics, weapons, AI, or networking.
- Disables the additional camera behavior in vehicles by default.

## First launch

The addon creates this client profile file after a character camera is initialized:

`$profile:CamProject/bodycam.json`

Close the running game or Workbench play session before editing the profile file. Restart the session to reload it.

## Important settings

- `enabled`: Master switch.
- `forceFirstPersonOnFoot`: Locks the bodycam experience to first person while on foot.
- `disableInVehicles`: Leaves Reforger's vehicle cameras unchanged.
- `proceduralGaitEnabled`: Optional experimental extra gait cycle. Leave this `false` for clean vanilla weapon motion.
- `offsetRight`, `offsetUp`, `offsetForward`: Camera-space offset in metres.
- `movementAmount`: Overall gait motion multiplier; valid range is 0–2.
- `walkTranslation`, `sprintTranslation`: Positional gait amplitude in metres.
- `walkRotation`, `sprintRotation`: Rotational gait amplitude in degrees.
- `accelerationTranslation`, `accelerationRotation`: Start/stop and direction-change inertia.
- `adsStabilization`: Fraction of the effect removed during the ADS transition; keep this at `1` for collision-free sight alignment.
- `adsTransitionLead`: How early bodycam displacement fades during ADS. The default `2.5` finishes removal at 40% of the engine transition.
- `breathingTranslation`, `breathingRotation`: Subtle idle movement.

Invalid or extreme motion values are clamped when the configuration loads.

## Testing checklist

1. Test standing still, walking, jogging, sprinting, crouching, and prone.
2. Test hip fire and ADS with iron sights, red dots, and magnified optics.
3. Check walls, doorframes, tight interiors, ladders, vaulting, falling, and unconscious states.
4. Enter driver, passenger, and turret positions to confirm vanilla vehicle cameras remain intact.
5. Test mouse/controller sensitivity and at least two aspect ratios.
6. Test player-hosted and dedicated multiplayer before adding authoritative gameplay changes.

## Planned layers

1. Camera comfort options and in-game configuration UI.
2. Subtle bodycam post-processing and optional overlay.
3. Event-driven recoil, explosion, suppression, and injury presentation.
4. Local combat-audio perspective.
5. Weapon inertia, point shooting, collision behavior, and animation work.
6. Optional server-authoritative realism rules for damage and stamina.

## Compatibility

The implementation modifies `SCR_CharacterCameraHandlerComponent`. Other addons that override the same camera methods may conflict or combine unpredictably. Keep global camera mods disabled while evaluating this framework.

## ADS and weapon animation behavior

The first-person lock only intercepts an actual third-person camera state. It deliberately leaves Reforger's ADS, magnified optic, picture-in-picture, focus, and weapon-obstruction camera selection alone. Bodycam stabilization follows the engine's continuous ADS animation progress instead of switching from a hip-fire state to an ADS state as a boolean step. Bodycam translation, breathing, and inertia are completely removed before the sight reaches the eye, preventing the camera near plane from intersecting rear-sight or optic geometry.

mods.description:
# Emergency Response Simulator

This addon now contains a standalone first-pass callout loop for law-enforcement style missions in Arma Reforger.

Mission definitions can now be overridden from a JSON file stored in the local Arma profile container.

The dispatcher manager now also spawns a client HUD panel that shows the active call code, title, details, and recent dispatch traffic.

Mission sites can also run configurable event effects from JSON, such as persistent smoke/fire effect prefabs on activation and one-shot explosion particles/sounds.

Structure fire calls now also show a top-center fire alert banner for players while the incident is active.

## What It Does

- Registers multiple scripted callout locations placed in the world.
- Automatically activates one location at a time.
- Marks the active location through its map descriptor label.
- Resolves the callout when an entity enters the active trigger radius.
- Immediately rolls the next callout when looping is enabled.
- Spawns configured event effects when a mission becomes active or resolves.

## Files

- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutManagerComponent.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutSiteEntity.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutRegistry.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutSiteState.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutMissionConfig.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutEventEffectPlayer.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutProfileConfig.c`
- `Scripts/Game/Callouts/ERS_CalloutConfigStore.c`
- `UI/Layouts/HUD/ERS_DispatchHud.layout`
- `Prefabs/ERS/Callouts/ERS_CalloutMissionOrb.et`
- `Docs/missions.example.json`

## Workbench Setup

1. Create a world entity that will act as the dispatcher manager.
2. Attach `ERS_CalloutManagerComponent` to that entity.
3. Create one trigger entity or prefab per response location using `ERS_CalloutSiteEntity` as the scripted class.
4. Or place `Prefabs/ERS/Callouts/ERS_CalloutMissionOrb.et` and duplicate it for each mission location.
5. Set each site's `Mission ID` to a mission entry in the profile JSON container.
6. For fire/explosion calls, add event effects under that mission entry in JSON.
7. Use the site title, summary, dispatch code, and radius as fallback defaults when a JSON override is missing.
8. Add `SCR_MapDescriptorComponent` to each callout site if you want its current state reflected on the map.
9. Launch the world on a dedicated or hosted server context so the server-side registration path runs.

## HUD Behavior

When a client joins a world that contains the dispatcher manager, the addon creates a dispatch HUD panel in the top-right of the screen.

- The panel starts in `STANDBY`.
- When the server activates a callout, the HUD updates with the active mission code, title, and summary.
- Recent dispatch traffic is kept in a short three-line feed.
- Late-joining clients request the current state from the server once the HUD is created.
- Active fire missions show a `STRUCTURE FIRE REPORTED` banner near the top center of the screen.
- The banner is enabled for active missions whose mission ID, title, or summary contains fire/smoke wording, including `structure-fire-001`.

## Profile Container

At runtime, the addon now creates this profile directory and JSON container automatically if they do not exist:

- `$profile:EmergencyResponseSimulator`
- `$profile:EmergencyResponseSimulator/Callouts`
- `$profile:EmergencyResponseSimulator/Callouts/missions.json`

The default `missions.json` file contains sample missions keyed by mission ID. Each placed callout site points at one of those IDs.

Existing profile JSON files are not overwritten. If a server already generated `missions.json`, either add the new fields manually or remove the file once so the addon can rebuild it with the latest defaults.

`Docs/missions.example.json` shows the same structure in a repo-local file you can use as a reference while editing the generated profile JSON.

### Event Effects

Each mission can include `m_aEventEffects`. An effect can run when the mission becomes `ACTIVE`, when it is `RESOLVED`, or on `BOTH`.

Common fields:

- `m_sEffectType`: `PREFAB`, `SMOKE`, `FIRE`, `PARTICLE`, or `EXPLOSION`.
- `m_sPrefabResource`: effect entity prefab to spawn for persistent fire/smoke/orb effects.
- `m_sParticleResource`: particle resource used for one-shot particle/explosion effects.
- `m_sSoundProject` and `m_sSoundEvent`: optional sound project/event for particle effects.
- `m_fOffsetX`, `m_fOffsetY`, `m_fOffsetZ`: spawn offset from the placed callout orb.
- `m_iDelayMs`: delay before the effect fires.
- `m_iCleanupMs`: automatic cleanup time. Use `0` for persistent prefabs that should stay until the callout resolves.

The generated `structure-fire-001` sample uses the red smoke effect prefab from the reference mission system plus a delayed TNT explosion particle/sound. Swap `m_sPrefabResource` for the exact fire prefab you want to use.

## Current Behavior Limits

- This first pass is standalone and does not depend on the older CAD addon.
- Missions are still anchored to placed world sites. The JSON file currently controls mission metadata and trigger radius, not dynamic world spawning.
- Any entity entering the active trigger will resolve the callout. If you want player-only or faction-only resolution, that filter should be added next.
- The marker label is updated, but marker visibility is not toggled here because that API was not verified from the local references.
- Event effects are visual/audio only. Explosion effects currently do not apply damage or force.

mods.description:
# Forced Labor and Enslavement Framework - Bank2

Arma Reforger role-play framework for server-authoritative enslavement,
forced-work assignments, contract transfer, Bank2 payments, escort, and release.

## Required addon

- Bank 2: `66D142CC782DE5BD`

Bank2 supplies `Bnk_BankComponent`, its persistent account manager, ATM interface,
and the cash HUD through its dependency tree. No separate phone system or older
bank addon is required.

The scenario must contain Bank2's `Prefabs/BankManager.et`. If it is missing,
money operations fail safely without changing ownership or balances. The included
`TestSlave.ent` already contains the manager and a Bank2 ATM.

## Gameplay

1. Approach another living character and use **Enslave**.
2. The target immediately becomes enslaved and can be assigned forced work.
3. The enslaved character may move for work but cannot aim or fire.
4. The holder can start and stop escorting the enslaved player.
5. Another player can use **Buy enslaved contract ($20,000)**.
6. The enslaved player can pay the configured release fee through Bank2.
7. Release restores normal movement and weapon controls.

There is no accept/refuse prompt and no escape interaction or escape roll.
The Enslave interaction is hidden for dead characters.

## Online players

The project merges its status component and actions into
`Prefabs/Characters/Core/Character_Base.et`. Bank2 patches the same shared base
with its account component. Players who join after mission start inherit both
systems when their character spawns.

## Server authority and persistence

Enslavement, work progress, escort state, transfers, release, and all Bank2
balance changes are initiated by the server. A two-part payment is rolled back if
the second account update fails.

The server creates:

- `$profile:ForcedLaborFramework/FLF_Settings.json`
- `$profile:ForcedLaborFramework/FLF_Contracts.json` when enabled

Bank2 owns bank-account and cash persistence. This addon does not define a bank
component or create a second account database.

## Install

Remove every older build of this framework before loading this one because they
share addon GUID `69E84C62CFE4C475`. Install Bank2 and its dependencies on the
server and clients, then add this addon after Bank2 in the server mod list.

Test with the complete RP mod list before public deployment.

mods.name: Peace Time Mod
mods.title: Peace Time Mod
mods.description:
# Peace Time Mod

Peacetime is controlled manually from **Game Master → Scenario Properties →
Game Settings → Peacetime**. It starts disabled whenever the server starts.

The mod overrides vanilla `EditorModeEdit.et` and adds a second attribute list
to its existing `SCR_AttributesManagerEditorComponent`. The original vanilla
`Edit.conf` list remains intact; the mod does not replace it.

While active:

- All damage transactions against player and AI characters are rejected on the server.
- Guns, melee, explosives, vehicle impacts, and indirect damage cannot injure or kill characters.
- Every player receives a 12-second **PEACETIME ENACTED** popup when peacetime
  begins or when they spawn during the active window.
- Players already present also receive the notice when peacetime is enacted.
- A custom 12-second layout banner announces both enabling and disabling.

The Scenario Properties panel provides a **Peacetime** checkbox:

- **Enabled** — immediately enacts peacetime.
- **Disabled** — immediately ends peacetime.

The selected state lasts until a Game Master changes it or the server restarts.
Scenario Property changes execute on the server. The server log prints Game
Master transitions with the `[Peace Time Mod]` prefix.

Standalone law-enforcement MDT prototype for Arma Reforger.

## Current features

- Opens and closes with keyboard **I**
- Citizen-record search
- Incident-report creation
- Session report browser
- Escape/back closes the MDT

persistence component can replace the prototype store without rewriting the UI.

Open `addon.gproj` in Arma Reforger Workbench, allow resources to register, start a
play session, possess a character, and press **I**.

This addon blocks the vanilla Bohemia `SCR_LootDeadBodyAction` only for dead player bodies whose Bohemia Player Identity GUID is listed in JSON.

Runtime JSON path:

`$profile:Stop Looting/Stop Looting Officers.json`

The file is auto-created on mission start. Add officer GUIDs under `Data.OfficerIdentityIds`, `Data.OfficerGuids`, or `Data.OfficerEntries[].IdentityId`. Non-listed bodies keep the normal Search Character behavior.

Example JSON is included at `Config/Stop Looting Officers.example.json`.

mods.description:
# Thunder Buddies Economy

Thunder Buddies Economy combines the RP phone, bank, cash/shop, and auction
systems into one Arma Reforger addon.

## Required dependencies

- Arma Reforger (`58D0FB3206B6F859`)
- Enfusion Database Framework (`5D6EA74A94173EDF`)
- Enfusion Persistence Framework (`5D6EBC81EB1842EF`)
- TBS RP Linking System (`69AB1681D36D016C`)

Use EDF 0.6.10 and EPF 0.6.18 (or newer compatible releases) with Arma Reforger
1.7.

Do not load the original separate ShopSystem, Bank2, or Auction2 addons beside
this unified addon. Their original resource GUIDs are intentionally retained
here, so loading both copies creates duplicate-resource conflicts.

Do not load the separate RPPhone addon beside this unified addon either. Its
phone resources and scripts are now included here.

The old RPPhone vehicle-sale and impound extensions are excluded because their
GarageRP dependency targets the older Arma/EPF scripting API and does not
compile on Arma Reforger 1.7. Phone messaging, bank transfers, jobs, identities,
groups, police tablet, fines, reports, licenses, restraints, resource trading,
gang zones, and robbery features remain included.

## RP phone

Use the `GadgetWatch` input (gamepad D-pad down in the included input config) to
open the phone. Police jobs open the police tablet variant.

Phone-to-phone bank transfers are atomic server transactions: the server
derives the sender, checks the live balance and recipient, subtracts from the
sender, credits the recipient, persists both balances, and reports both ledger
events to TBS RP Linking System.

## Test scenario

Open `Worlds/Testin.ent`, or select the `Thunder Economy Test Range` mission.
The test area contains:

- a bank manager with EPF persistence;
- the phone's persistent crime, police-chat, and report managers;
- a combined ATM with Bank and Auction House actions;
- an item shop configured for cash purchase and resale;
- cash pickups;
- shop-enabled player-controller and character prefabs;
- nearby faction spawn points.

Test multiplayer transactions with at least two clients before publishing:

1. Open the phone on two clients and transfer bank money between them.
2. Pick up cash and deposit/withdraw at the bank.
3. Buy and sell the configured shop item.
4. List a non-cash inventory item at the auction house.
5. Buy it from the second client.
6. Claim the seller payout and reconnect to verify persistence.

All transaction amounts and ownership are revalidated by the server. Confirmed
cash and bank changes are reported to TBS RP Linking System as
`ThunderEconomy` events.

mods.title: TBS PROPERTY MOD
mods.description:
# TBS Property Mod

## Bank 2 rebuild

This build initializes property actions directly when the nested door entity is
created. Buy and Rent no longer disappear while a client is waiting for replicated
property state. Purchase, release, lock, unlock, add-player, and remove-player
requests are routed to the server, where ownership and the Bank 2 balance are
validated before anything changes.

Use the standalone prefab:

`Prefabs/TBS/Properties/TBS_GuardHouse_02_Property.et`

Its interaction point is centered on the exterior handle plate with a 3 metre activation
radius. An unowned property shows Purchase and Rent. It never shows the vanilla
Open action. After purchase it shows the property door and owner-only controls.

Server-authoritative multiplayer house ownership for Arma Reforger integrated with
**Bank 2**.

Ownership, lock state, and the complete guest access list are saved to:

`$profile:TBS Property Mod/properties.json`

## Features

- Includes a standalone drag-ready GuardHouse property prefab under
  `Prefabs/TBS/Properties`.
- Buy or rent configured vanilla houses using the player's Bank 2 account.
- Automatic stable property IDs based on the world and building position.
- Lock and unlock owned properties.
- Add or remove the nearest player from the persistent access list.
- Owners and saved guests can use unlocked property doors and protected storage.
- Multiple configured doors on the same building share one property record.
- Server-authoritative JSON persistence across restarts.

## Configure vanilla houses

Vanilla house prefabs do not share one universal door prefab. Override every
residential door prefab used by the server maps once. Every placed instance of an
overridden prefab then becomes a separate property automatically.

For every overridden exterior residential door prefab:

1. Keep `BaseDoorComponent`.
2. Add `RplComponent` if the door does not already have one.
3. Add `TBS_PropertyDoorComponent`.
4. Leave **Property Id** blank for an automatic stable ID. Use a manual ID only when
   migrating an existing production property.
5. Remove `SCR_DoorUserAction`, because it bypasses property locks.
6. Add these server-authoritative actions to the exterior action context:
   - `TBS_UsePropertyDoorAction`
   - `TBS_BuyPropertyAction`
   - `TBS_RentPropertyAction` (optional)
   - `TBS_LockPropertyAction`
   - `TBS_UnlockPropertyAction`
   - `TBS_AddPropertyPlayerAction`
   - `TBS_RemovePropertyPlayerAction`
   - `TBS_ReleasePropertyAction`
7. Set the purchase and rental prices. Defaults are `$1,000` to buy and `$250`
   to rent.

All configured doors beneath the same top-level building entity receive the same
automatic ID. A house with front and rear entrances therefore has one owner, one
guest list, and one lock state.

Do not move configured production buildings after data has been saved. Give movable
or replaceable buildings a permanent manual Property Id.

## Player access

The owner and target player must stand within **Guest Manage Radius** of one another
(5 metres by default) at the property.

- **Add nearest player to property** grants persistent access.
- **Remove nearest player from property** revokes it.
- Guests can use property doors while the owner has them unlocked, plus protected
  property storage.
- Only the owner can lock, unlock, manage guests, or release the property.
- Releasing clears the owner, lock, and entire guest list.

## Door locking

A property that has not been purchased or rented is sealed: the Open/Close action is
hidden and only the Buy/Rent choices are shown. A newly purchased property starts
locked. The owner must unlock it before use. Even while unlocked, only the owner and
players added to the property can operate the door.

`TBS_UsePropertyDoorAction` replaces `SCR_DoorUserAction` on every protected
entrance. Remove explicit vanilla door actions from the override when possible. The
runtime protection also blocks inherited vanilla door actions throughout a
configured property building.

## Property storage

Place a storage entity inside a house and add `TBS_OpenPropertyStorageAction` to its
action context. Leave its Property Id blank to use the nearest configured property
door, or enter the same explicit Property Id used by the entrance.

The default automatic search radius is 50 metres. Use explicit matching IDs when
nearby houses could resolve to the wrong entrance.

The storage access restriction is included. Vanilla Reforger does not automatically
persist arbitrary container contents, so storage item persistence requires a
separate serialization implementation.

## Existing save migration

Version 1 JSON saves load automatically. Existing owners are preserved. Their lock
starts unlocked and their guest list starts empty until changed.

## Bank 2

Bank 2 (`66D142CC782DE5BD`), Auction 2 (`66B8DE246CED60A2`), and Shop System
(`5D2D1436D1FA5A13`) must be loaded on the server and clients. Do not load RPPhone's
older Bank ATM addon (`64D15EA404F23ABD`) beside Bank 2 because both define the same
`Bnk_` script classes.

A purchase is accepted only when the player has `Bnk_BankComponent` and enough
replicated bank balance. The server deducts the price with `ServerSetBank`, so the
Bank 2 balance and the amount used to buy a property are the same account. For an
admin test balance, send this exact message in game chat:

`!tbsbank 5000`

The amount can be changed from 1 through 1,000,000. The command credits the sender's
Bank 2 account on the server. `TestProperty.ent` contains the compatible bank
manager needed by the included test world. Its balance is session-backed because
the test scenario does not use Bank 2 persistence. Production worlds must use the
Bank 2 manager and persistence configuration required by that addon.

## Rental rule

Rent is a single claim that lasts until the tenant releases the property. Timed
renewals need a server-authoritative real-time service because world time resets.

See `WORLD INTEGRATION GUIDE.md` for the server and map handoff procedure.

mods.description:
# Where Am I 2

Global multiplayer map tracking for Arma Reforger.

- Every connected, spawned player is visible to every client on the map.
- Markers show live position, heading, and player name.
- Factions are ignored.
- The server randomly assigns a bright color from a 16-color palette.
- Colors remain stable until the player disconnects; unused colors are preferred.
- Updates are server-authoritative every 500 ms and stale markers disappear after 3 seconds.

The addon modifies `SCR_BaseGameMode` and `SCR_MapMenuUI`, so no per-world prefab placement is required.
